Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
The $95 Traditional set is completely fine if you simply want a functional, budget-friendly set to play the game on the go. It includes 166 melamine mini tiles, 4 basic clear plastic racks, dice, and a carry bag—everything required to play.
The $210 Mini Anywhere Series is worth the extra cost if you care about aesthetics and elevated materials. You get custom travel-themed Jokers (featuring illustrations like passports and luggage), upgraded colored acrylic racks, a themed grab-bag, zipper tassel, and a choice of vibrant tile colors (blue, pink, green, or white).
If money is tight and you just want to play, the $95 set is more than enough! If you want a more stylish, gift-worthy setup with custom artwork and acrylic racks, the $210 set offers that upgraded experience.
